summary: Login screen renders preview credential hints for 9 roles but exposes quick-login buttons for only 6 of them. Vendor, Manager, and HRMS Employee preview buttons are absent from the UI despite their credentials being advertised in the hint banner.

findings.title: Missing 'Preview Vendor' quick-login button
findings.details: The credential hint panel lists Vendor preview credentials (3333333333 / OTP 123456), but no corresponding button or resource ID (e.g. qa_login_preview_vendor) is present in the rendered UI. The user is shown credentials they cannot use without manually typing them.
findings.expected: A 'Preview vendor' button with resource ID qa_login_preview_vendor, consistent with the other six role-preview buttons.
findings.observed: No vendor preview button rendered; only buyer, AC technician, pest control, delivery boy, service boy, and supplier buttons are present.

findings.title: Missing 'Preview Manager' quick-login button
findings.details: Manager credentials (7777777777) are advertised in the hint text but no qa_login_preview_manager button appears in the resource ID list or visible text buttons.
findings.expected: A 'Preview manager' button consistent with other role-preview buttons.

findings.title: Missing 'Preview HRMS Employee' quick-login button
findings.details: HRMS Employee credentials (6666666666) are advertised in the hint text but no qa_login_preview_hrms_employee button appears in the resource ID list or visible text buttons.
findings.expected: A 'Preview HRMS employee' button consistent with other role-preview buttons.
findings.observed: No HRMS employee preview button rendered.

findings.title: Supplier and Vendor preview access present on mobile login
findings.details: PRD §10 explicitly marks Supplier master data administration as out of scope for mobile. While a preview login for a Supplier/Vendor role is not the same as admin management, the credential hint and (for supplier) a working preview button suggest these roles are being tested on mobile. This should be confirmed intentional with the product owner.
findings.expected: Clarification in the PRD that read-only / operational supplier/vendor role access on mobile is in scope, even if master data administration is not.
findings.observed: qa_login_preview_supplier button rendered; supplier and vendor credentials both advertised in the hint panel.
